summary: Customers > Work Orders tab: WO number duplicates the shop ID in the workplace prefix
reported_issue: WO number incorrectly duplicates the shop ID when displayed in the Customers > Work Orders tab (e.g. shop id 2 shows S22-123 instead of S2-123), compounding with each shop ID change.
expected_after_fix: The WO number should display the correct shop ID prefix consistently across the app, including the Customers > Work Orders tab. Shop ID should never be duplicated.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin and opened the Work Orders tab; noted numbers render as S12-24939, S12-24579, etc. (current shop ID prefix = S12).
Confirmed via API GET /api/work-orders that the raw number field is 'S12-24939' (single, correct prefix).
Navigated to a customer detail page (11 A new Company) which routed to /customers/{id}/work-orders (Customers > Work Orders tab).
Read the WO numbers rendered in the Customers > Work Orders tab and compared them to the main Work Orders tab.
actual_now: Both the Work Orders tab and the Customers > Work Orders tab render identical, correctly-prefixed numbers (S12-24939, S12-24579, S12-23512, ...). No shop ID duplication was observed in the Customers > Work Orders tab. The API also returns the single correct prefix.
notes: Current staging shop ID prefix is S12. The reported duplication (e.g. S1212-) does not occur; prefix is consistent across tabs. Could not force a shop-ID change (Settings > Locations write) but the display-layer duplication described in the ticket is no longer present.
